thread_title: S. minor var. minor Nassau Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. minor var. minor Nassau Co, FL

posts.body_html:
Here's a population that has been crammed into community pots for eons and never really taken care of until last winter! This genetically rich group of plants has a few interesting color forms, like a reddish one and I think there's even a yellowish looking clone, we'll see! They've never really been given the space to grow out and color up to their fullest potential until now!

These traps are just starting to look interesting, I'll for sure update this thread in a month or two once the plants fill in and produce their best looking traps. These are actually divisions, the mother plants don't look as nice! Pics taken 8/6/21:


Here's one of the red ones, not even near its fullest color potential, but still beautiful:





Look at em DOE's....that's wanna be slang for windows. I guess you could take it further and call em John Doe's, that's not too weird, right? Okay, I'll stop talking:


How about some DOE's stenciled in with red lining?
